scene_type: 2D (label from inputs.json; small depth parallax visible, see notes)
pixel_convention: x right, y down, origin top-left of 1920x1080 frame; dy < 0 means moving UP

camera.motion: static (background mean abs diff vs frame 0 < 0.6 grey levels; wall/floor line fixed at y=687.5; chassis tail lights fixed)
camera.view: straight behind the truck, level, looking at the rear face; wall/floor line (horizon-like) at y = 687.5 across the image

objects.name: cargo_body
objects.description: white box body (cargo box) of the truck, rear face with roller door (white upper / dark lower), yellow outline tape, red/white chevron markers, 'DOLL' labels; together with the yellow-black chevron underride bar below it. It is lifted straight UP relative to the chassis.
objects.reference_point: centre of the rear face bounding box (origin proxy)
objects.notes: rigid translation; width constant 570 px (no change of depth)

objects.name: cardboard_box
objects.description: brown cardboard box sitting on/behind the top of the cargo body, open flap at top right (dark flap tip at x~945-1087)
objects.reference_point: horizontal centre of visible box; vertical cy_top_based = top edge + 87.8 px (half of the frame-0 visible height); the true bottom is hidden behind the body's roof edge
objects.notes: moves up less than the body (lags at start, decelerates and stops at the end); bottom partly hidden

objects.name: truck_chassis
objects.description: black lower rear of the truck: frame rails, red tail lights left and right, two small white reverse lights, rear bumper bar, red reflectors at bottom
objects.notes: static whole clip; extends nearly to image bottom; wheels not visible

objects.name: chevron_underride_bar
objects.description: yellow/black diagonal-striped bar directly below the cargo body
objects.notes: moves up with the cargo body (about y 910 -> 830 by frame 400); use cargo_body track

objects.name: warehouse_wall
objects.description: grey panelled back wall with horizontal seams and vertical pillars, ceiling lamps at top edge (x~110, 640, 1250, 1790)

objects.name: left_window_panel
objects.description: dark grey window/door panel at left of the wall

objects.name: floor
objects.description: light grey floor with soft shadows (truck shadow lower left)

events.note: moves from the start, very slowly (~0.07 px/frame over frames 0-10), speeding up throughout; still speeding up at the last frame (~0.30 px/frame over frames 390-400)
approx +-5 frames; box stays still for first ~12 frames while body already moves
